summary_en: This phase 1b study tests a response-guided approach to neoadjuvant (pre-surgery) chemotherapy in people with stage IB, II or III adenocarcinoma of the stomach or gastroesophageal junction. Patients receive one of the standard neoadjuvant regimens, FLOT or FOLFOX, given by intravenous infusion every 14 days for up to 6 months, and treatment may change based on response. The study aims to determine the efficacy and feasibility of this approach, but a specific main outcome measure is not stated.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1b evalúa un enfoque de quimioterapia neoadyuvante (antes de la cirugía) guiado por la respuesta, en personas con adenocarcinoma de estómago o de la unión gastroesofágica en estadio IB, II o III. Los pacientes reciben uno de los esquemas neoadyuvantes estándar, FLOT o FOLFOX, administrados por infusión intravenosa cada 14 días durante hasta 6 meses, y el tratamiento puede cambiar según la respuesta. El estudio busca determinar la eficacia y la factibilidad de este enfoque, pero no se indica una medida de resultado principal específica.
who_for: Adenocarcinoma of the stomach or gastroesophageal junction, confirmed by biopsy or cytology.
Stage IB, II or Stage III disease eligible for neoadjuvant doublet or triplet chemotherapy for up to 6 months.
ECOG performance status of 2 or less.
Life expectancy over 6 months, with adequate blood, liver and kidney function.
not_for: Known distant metastases from the gastroesophageal cancer.
Uncontrolled intercurrent illness, such as active infection or unstable heart conditions.
Another primary cancer needing active treatment or expected to need it within 12 months.
